text:
Omar (AE): Noah asked us to lock the POC acceptance doc this afternoon. A few unique asks from their legal team: explicit data deletion SLA after sandbox, ability to persist RAG indices to customer-owned storage, and a hallucination/factuality gate. Can we map to concrete gates and owners?

Lina (SE): got it. need traffic profile and golden prompt + fact-check set. also: what does their hallucination metric look like? do they want human verification or automated fact-check pass rate?

Noah (Buyer): traffic: sustained 24 qps, short bursts to 85 qps, avg input 140 tokens, avg output 100 tokens, monthly approx 1.25M request-equivalents. For hallucination: they want a human-verified factuality sample (n=200) with <=2% hallucination rate, plus automated fact-checker pass >= 92% as a soft gate.

Hank (Eng): we can do that. plan: hosted canary 48h replay + dedicated mini-pool if canary passes. For RAG indices we support two options: (A) temp indices stored in Redwood-managed EU S3 (default retention) or (B) persist indices to customer S3 using their credentials (preferred for legal). We'll document the pipeline and IAM policy.

Carla (Legal): data deletion SLA needs to be explicit: upon contract termination or sandbox end, Redwood deletes temporary indices and request logs within 7 days by default; customer can request immediate purge and well confirm within 48h. Also need an appendix on what we retain for billing (aggregated metrics only, no raw prompts stored beyond retention window).

Lina (SE): propose acceptance gates (draft):
1) Perf gate: p95 <= 260ms for single-turn generation under the agreed mixed replay (sustained 24 qps, peak 85 qps) measured over a 48h canary window; error rate <0.5%.
2) Cost gate: modeled monthly burn <= $300 per 1M request-equivalents (we'll provide tokenization math and two scenarios: hosted PAYG and dedicated reserved).
3) Quality gate: automatic: automated fact-checker pass >= 92% on the 1k automated set; human: human-verified hallucination rate <= 2% on a blind sample (n=200). Also require end-to-end BLEU/ROUGE-L drop <=1.5% vs baseline.
4) Data gate: RAG index persistence option validated (customer S3 write tested) AND data deletion SLA acknowledged in writing.
5) Compliance gate: KMS BYOK option validated, SAML SSO tested, and SOC2 excerpt provided.

Omar (AE): who signs each gate? proposal: Redwood ops confirms perf + cost, customer legal signs data and compliance gate, and customer product signs quality gate after reviewing human eval. We'll put explicit sign-off checkboxes in the doc.

Hank (Eng): perf harness snippet to run (paste into runner):
```
profile: mixed_rag
sustained_qps: 24
peak_qps: 85
p50_seq_len: 180
p95_seq_len: 760
duration: 3h
metrics: p50,p95,p99,errors,token_burn,fact_check_pass
```
We'll run fp16 and 8-bit quantized variants and include per-example diffs for the human set.

Noah (Buyer): on cost gate: please show two tables: (A) hosted PAYG (per-token) with estimated month burn and free credit applied; (B) dedicated reserved node amortized monthly cost + burst overage math. Also show sensitivity to batching window (0/10/25ms).

Lina (SE): we'll include a tokenization example in the doc: 
```
Example payload: input 140 tokens, output 100 tokens -> request-equivalent = 240 tokens -> used to compute per-M request cost
```
And a batching sensitivity table.

Carla (Legal): add that the deletion confirmation will be an emailed attestation to the customer's security contact with a timestamp and a job id referencing the purge job. Also include the exception: anonymized aggregated metrics used for product analytics may persist for 12 months; raw request texts will be deleted per SLA.

ops-bot: runbook created: /runbooks/presales/2305550000-poc-legal-data-retention-runbook.md :white_check_mark:

Hank (Eng): rollback & notification plan: auto-shift traffic to baseline model if p95 > threshold for 10 continuous minutes OR hallucination rate on recent sample > 3% OR error rate >0.6% for 5 minutes. Paging order: Lina (SE) -> Hank (Eng) -> Omar (AE). MTTR target 30 minutes. Runbook will include a curl example to flip traffic.

Lina (SE): human evaluation plan: well sample n=200 outputs blind and have their SME label factual vs hallucinated. Well also compute inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's alpha) and include it in the report; if alpha < 0.6 well expand the sample. Customer signs quality gate only after human sample review.

Noah (Buyer): that works. also need a short appendix on log access for debugging: during sandbox we grant read-only access to aggregated dashboards and per-request IDs (no raw prompts) unless customer requests a secure audit session.

Carla (Legal): include a short clause: customer may request an audit session where Redwood can present raw prompts in a secure environment for debugging; such sessions require an NDA amendment and are limited to X hours per quarter (we'll fill X in draft).

Omar (AE): timeline & owners:
- Today EOD: Lina uploads golden and fact-check sets + run harness.
- +24h: Hank posts perf + quantized comparison and cost scenario table.
- +48h: Lina runs human sample process and posts human eval results (n=200) and Krippendorff alpha.
- +72h: final acceptance doc compiled and sent to Noah for sign-off.
Owners: Lina (golden sets, perf harness, run), Hank (perf runs & cost), Carla (legal language & deletion SLA), Omar (acceptance doc & customer comms).

Noah (Buyer): please also include specific commands or dashboards we'll use to verify gates. We want a clear checklist for sign-off.

Lina (SE): will add the checklist with links to the p95 dashboard, token burn report, fact-check automation dashboard, and the human-eval spreadsheet. Also include the exact query to compute p95 via API.

Hank (Eng): one more technical note: 8-bit quantization improves throughput ~1.5x on decoding-heavy loads, but well highlight any human-eval regressions >1% hallucination introduced by quantization. Recommend starting fp16 for canary, then test quantized in a controlled pass.

Omar (AE): thanks team  I'll compile the draft acceptance doc and circulate for sign-off once assets are in. Booked a 30-min review with Noah for Friday 3pm PT. :thumbsup:
